headlines.title: Trump posts that 'no talks or conversations' are scheduled with Iran
headlines.description: In a social media post, President Trump said that "no talks or conversations" were ongoing or are scheduled with Iran amid the ongoing conflict. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports on the latest developments in the Middle East.

headlines.title: New Details Emerge on Hayden Panettiere’s Sudden Death
headlines.description: Officials say Hayden Panettiere was in cardiac arrest when paramedics responded to a 911 call on Sunday afternoon in the South Carolina home where she had been staying. “EMS personnel initiated advance cardiac life support measures, however, resuscitation efforts were unsuccessful,” the coroner said in a statement. The official cause of death is still under investigation. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Primary Candidates With the Same Name Sparks Confusion
headlines.description: Voters in California, Florida, Wyoming and Alaska are heading to the polls where candidates with the same name in the same race are sparking confusion and harsh accusations. In Alaska, a reliably red state that President Donald Trump carried three times, a Republican incumbent is seeking a third term but has a strong challenger across the aisle whose name sounds a little too familiar. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Penn State Frat Brothers Charged in Alleged Cocaine Trafficking
headlines.description: Thirteen current and former students at Penn State University are charged in connection with an off-campus cocaine ring. Authorities allege senior members of Delta Upsilon and Sigma Chi ran the operation inside their fraternities between 2023 and 2024. Officials say the suspects used new pledges to cut and package the drugs.

headlines.title: Disney and ABC sue FCC, accusing Trump administration of ‘retaliatory campaign’
headlines.description: The Walt Disney Co. and ABC sued the FCC, seeking to stop an early license renewal process that they say is an attack by the Trump administration.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Teacher says 8-foot python blamed by officials for Virginia school fire is innocent
headlines.description: Firefighters battling a blaze at a Bedford County, Virginia, middle school encountered more than just smoke.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ex-boyfriend was at scene when she died, police report says
headlines.description: Hayden Panettiere’s boyfriend and his brother were at the South Carolina apartment complex where the ‘Heroes’ actor went into cardiac arrest and died Sunday.

headlines.title: Suspect in Chucky-style mask wanted on assault in Philadelphia after chasing jogger, police say
headlines.description: Philadelphia police asked for the public’s help to find a man wanted on assault who donned a Chucky-style horror mask and “made threatening comments” while chasing a woman near City Hall, officials said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Andy Burnham says he’s not embarrassed about messaging someone impersonating a Trump aide
headlines.description: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he’s not embarrassed about exchanging messages with someone who impersonated President Donald Trump’s White House chief of staff, Susie Wiles.
